name: R1-csv-airtravel
text: A public data file is at https://people.sc.fsu.edu/~jburkardt/data/csv/airtravel.csv (monthly airline passengers). Read it and tell me which month had the most passengers in 1960 and how many, and how many more passengers July 1960 had than July 1958.

name: R2-xlsx-rows
text: A public Excel file is at https://freetestdata.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Free_Test_Data_100KB_XLSX.xlsx. Tell me the column headings of its first sheet and exactly how many data rows it has (not counting the heading row or empty rows).

name: R3-pptx-slide
text: A public PowerPoint file is at https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx/raw/master/features/steps/test_files/test.pptx. How many slides does it have, and what are the title and the subtitle text on the slide?

name: R4-article-essay
text: This tab shows a long essay. Give me its title, the month and year it was published, and the three qualities the essay says the work you choose needs to have. Work from the essay text only.

name: R5-page-data
text: On this page find the data the site publishes about itself: its social media profile links and the titles of the RSS feeds it offers. List them exactly.

name: R6-endless-quotes
text: This page is an endless list of quotes that loads more as you scroll. Load all of them. Tell me how many quotes there are in total and the author of the very last one.

name: N1-npm-express
text: On npmjs.com find the latest published version of the package express and its licence. Give both exactly as the page shows them.

name: N2-pypi-requests
text: On PyPI find the latest version of the package requests, the Python versions it requires, and its licence.

name: N3-wiki-go
text: On this Wikipedia page find who designed the Go programming language and the year it first appeared. Give all designers by name.

name: N4-selenium-form
text: Fill in the text input with "Xroga Acceptance", the textarea with "Second sample", pick the second option of the select, then submit the form and report the exact confirmation message shown.

name: N5-github-react
text: On this GitHub repository find the latest release: its tag and publication date, from the releases page.

name: N6-python-functools
text: On this Python documentation page find in which Python version the function functools.cache was added, and what it is described as being equivalent to.

name: S1-pdf-sections
text: A research paper is at https://arxiv.org/pdf/1512.03385 . Read its first two pages and list the section headings you find, in order, with their numbers if they have one.

name: S2-sitemap-python
text: Using the site's own sitemap and robots.txt (not the pages), tell me which Python documentation version folders https://docs.python.org lists in its sitemap, and whether its robots.txt tells crawlers to avoid /dev.

name: S3-notebook
text: A Jupyter notebook is at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jakevdp/PythonDataScienceHandbook/master/notebooks/00.00-Preface.ipynb . Tell me the title of the notebook and the heading of its first section.

name: S4-calendar
text: A calendar file is at https://www.thunderbird.net/media/caldata/autogen/USHolidays.ics . On what date is Thanksgiving Day in 2027, and how many events does the calendar hold in total?

name: S5-subtitles
text: A subtitle file is at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brenopolanski/html5-video-webvtt-example/master/MIB2-subtitles-pt-BR.vtt . What is the very first line spoken and at what time does it start?

name: S6-email
text: An email message file is at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikel/mail/master/spec/fixtures/emails/plain_emails/basic_email.eml . Who sent it, what is its subject, and what date does it carry?
